upstream.name: VAmPI (erev0s/VAmPI)
upstream.role: intentionally vulnerable OpenAPI 3 multi-user application, upstream MIT licensed
upstream.source_export: git archive of the pinned commit; no patch, fork, branch or working-tree edit is permitted

runtime.config_source: upstream environment variables read by app.py; no source edit
runtime.notes: vulnerable=1 is the upstream default and the upstream documented vulnerable mode; README lists Broken Object Level Authorization among the intended flaws. tokentimetolive raises the upstream 60 s bearer lifetime to 3600 s so a single session does not expire mid-assessment; it changes no authorization decision.

container.image_id_stability: the image ID is recorded, not required: it varies with build timestamps. Reproducibility is enforced on the pinned base digest, the pinned upstream tree manifest and the Containerfile hash.

documents_flaw.class: broken object level authorization on a private free-text field
documents_flaw.upstream_statement: README.md, 'Flow of actions': 'Each book is unique for every user and only the owner of the book should be allowed to view the secret'; README.md 'List of Vulnerabilities' names Broken Object Level Authorization.
documents_flaw.secondary_upstream_flaw: an authenticated account may change another account's password (api_views/users.py update_password, vulnerable branch), which is web.forbidden-state-change.v1's class (notes/plan.md 6.6)
documents_flaw.no_local_mutation: The exercised flaw is upstream behaviour in the pinned revision. This target defines no patch file, no fork and no working-tree change.
